===== SCN-001.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Saving bookmarks

  Scenario: Save the first bookmark using page details
    Given the personal bookmark collection is empty
    When the user submits the address of a web page
    Then one bookmark is saved
    And the bookmark card shows the site's name and icon
    And the bookmark card shows the page title and a short description
    And the bookmark card shows the saved web address
    And the user did not need to type those page details

## Assumptions
===== SCN-002.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Saving bookmarks

  Scenario: Adjust collected details before saving
    Given the user is adding a new bookmark
    When the user pastes a valid web address
    Then the collected title and description appear automatically
    And no separate action is required to collect them
    When the user adjusts the title and description and saves the bookmark
    Then the bookmark card shows the adjusted title and description
    And the site name, site icon, and web address still identify the original page

## Assumptions
===== SCN-003.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Managing saved bookmarks

  Scenario: Edit the wording of an existing bookmark
    Given a bookmark is present in the collection
    When the user selects the visible Edit action on its card
    Then an editor opens with the bookmark's current title and description
    When the user changes the title and description and saves
    Then the existing card immediately shows the changed wording
    And the page does not reload
    And the bookmark's site name, icon, and web address remain unchanged

## Assumptions
===== SCN-004.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Preventing duplicate bookmarks

  Scenario: Save an address that is already in the collection
    Given one bookmark has already been saved for a web address
    When the user attempts to add that exact web address again
    Then no additional bookmark is created
    And the existing bookmark's editor opens without a separate warning
    When the user adjusts the title and saves
    Then the existing card immediately shows the adjusted title
    And the collection still contains one bookmark

## Assumptions
===== SCN-005.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Finding saved bookmarks

  Scenario: Narrow bookmarks while typing a remembered word
    Given the collection contains bookmarks with different titles and descriptions
    When the user types a word that appears in one bookmark's description
    Then the collection immediately shows the matching bookmark without a separate submit action
    And the result count immediately reflects the visible matches

  Scenario Outline: Match searchable bookmark details
    Given a saved bookmark has a known <field>
    When the user types wording from that <field>
    Then the matching bookmark is included in the visible results

    Examples:
      | field       |
      | title       |
      | description |
      | site name   |
      | web address |

## Assumptions
===== SCN-006.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Finding saved bookmarks

  Scenario: Search using different capitalization
    Given a bookmark contains the word "fluffy" in its description
    When the user enters "Fluffy" in the live search box
    Then the bookmark is included in the visible results
    And the result count shows one result

## Assumptions
===== SCN-007.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Organizing bookmarks with labels

  Scenario: Show bookmarks carrying a selected label
    Given the collection includes two bookmarks labelled "Recipes"
    And labels are shown as a row of chips above the collection
    When the user selects the "Recipes" chip
    Then only the two recipe bookmarks are visible
    And the result count shows two results
    And the live search box remains available
    And the "Recipes" label is visible on each result card

## Assumptions
===== SCN-008.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Organizing bookmarks with labels

  Scenario: Add a newly created label alongside an existing label
    Given a bookmark already has the label "Recipes"
    And the collection has a known set of existing labels
    When the user opens the bookmark editor
    Then the label picker offers the existing labels for selection
    When the user creates and selects the label "Weekend plans"
    And saves the bookmark
    Then the card shows both "Recipes" and "Weekend plans"

## Assumptions
===== SCN-009.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Saving bookmarks with labels

  Scenario: Label a bookmark during its initial save
    Given the user has pasted a valid link into the save pop-up
    When the page title and description appear automatically
    Then the label picker appears alongside those editable details
    When the user selects "Recipes"
    And creates and selects "Weekend plans"
    And saves the bookmark
    Then the new card shows both "Recipes" and "Weekend plans"

===== SCN-010.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Reading saved bookmarks later

  Scenario: Add a bookmark to the reading list and view it
    Given the collection contains one bookmark already marked to read later
    And another bookmark is not marked
    When the user checks "Read later" on the unmarked bookmark
    And selects the "Read later" collection filter
    Then both marked bookmarks are visible
    And the result count shows two results
    And live search remains available

## Assumptions
===== SCN-011.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Reading saved bookmarks later

  Scenario: Remove a completed bookmark from the reading list
    Given the Read later view contains two marked bookmarks
    When the user unchecks "Read later" on one bookmark
    Then that bookmark immediately disappears from the Read later view
    And the result count changes to one result
    And the other marked bookmark remains visible

## Assumptions
===== SCN-012.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Managing saved bookmarks

  Scenario: Permanently delete a bookmark
    Given a bookmark is present in the collection
    When the user opens its editor
    And selects Delete bookmark
    Then a confirmation identifies the bookmark
    And the confirmation states that deletion is permanent
    When the user confirms deletion
    Then the bookmark is removed from the collection
    And the collection count decreases immediately

## Assumptions
===== SCN-013.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Managing bookmarks in bulk

  Scenario: Select and permanently delete several bookmarks
    Given the collection contains six bookmarks
    When the user enters selection mode
    And selects two bookmarks
    Then the bulk action bar shows two selected
    When the user chooses to delete the selection
    Then a confirmation states that two bookmarks will be permanently deleted and cannot be restored
    When the user confirms
    Then the selected bookmarks are removed
    And the collection count shows four saved

  Scenario: Leave selection mode without acting
    Given the user is in selection mode
    When the user selects Done selecting
    Then the collection returns to ordinary browsing mode

## Assumptions
===== SCN-014.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Managing bookmarks in bulk

  Scenario: Add a shared label while preserving existing labels
    Given two bookmarks are selected
    And the first bookmark has the label "Recipes"
    And the second bookmark has the label "Travel"
    When the user applies the existing label "Work" to the selection
    Then the first bookmark shows "Recipes" and "Work"
    And the second bookmark shows "Travel" and "Work"
    And both bookmarks remain selected
    And the action bar still shows two selected

## Assumptions
===== SCN-015.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Managing bookmarks in bulk

  Scenario: Add several bookmarks to the reading list
    Given two unmarked bookmarks are selected
    And another bookmark is already marked to read later
    When the user applies Mark read later to the selection
    And opens the Read later view
    Then all three bookmarks are visible
    And the result count shows three results
    And the original two bookmarks remain selected

  Scenario: Include an already-marked bookmark in a batch
    Given a selection contains a bookmark already marked to read later
    When the user applies Mark read later
    Then that bookmark remains marked

## Assumptions
===== SCN-016.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Archiving bookmarks

  Scenario: Hide a bookmark without deleting it
    Given a bookmark is visible in the everyday collection
    When the user opens its editor and archives it
    Then the bookmark is absent from the everyday collection
    And it is excluded from ordinary search
    And it is visible in the Archived view

  Scenario: Restore an archived bookmark
    Given an archived bookmark retains its title, description, labels, and Read later state
    When the user restores it
    Then the bookmark returns to the everyday collection
    And its title, description, labels, and Read later state are unchanged

## Assumptions
===== SCN-017.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Saving bookmarks

  Scenario: Page details cannot be collected
    Given the user has entered a valid page address
    And the page details cannot be collected
    Then the save pop-up explains that the details are unavailable
    And the site's name appears as an editable stand-in title
    And the description may remain empty
    When the user saves without changing the stand-in
    Then a bookmark is saved using the site name as its title

  Scenario: Replace the fallback title before saving
    Given the site name is shown as a fallback title
    When the user replaces it with personal wording and saves
    Then the bookmark card shows the personal wording

## Assumptions
===== SCN-018.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Saving bookmarks

  Scenario: Enter an incomplete web address
    Given the save pop-up is open
    When the user attempts to save "seriouseats.com/recipe"
    Then no bookmark is created
    And the save pop-up remains open
    And the address field explains that a full address beginning with http:// or https:// is required
    And the entered address is not silently changed

## Assumptions
===== SCN-019.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Finding saved bookmarks

  Scenario: Search has no matches
    Given the collection contains saved bookmarks
    When the user enters a query that matches none of them
    Then no bookmark cards are shown
    And the result count shows zero results
    And a clear No bookmarks found message is shown
    And the query remains unchanged
    When the user clears the query
    Then the full collection is restored

## Assumptions
===== SCN-020.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Organizing bookmarks with labels

  Scenario: Enter an existing label using different capitalization
    Given the label "Recipes" already exists
    And a bookmark currently has the label "Work"
    When the user attempts to create the label "recipes"
    Then the existing "Recipes" label is selected
    And the picker explains that the existing label was reused
    When the user saves
    Then the card shows "Work" and "Recipes"
    And no lowercase "recipes" label is created

  Scenario: Enter genuinely different label wording
    Given the label "Recipes" already exists
    When the user creates a label with different wording
    Then the app does not automatically merge it with "Recipes"

## Assumptions
===== SCN-021.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Displaying the bookmark collection

  Scenario: Display a bookmark with unusually long details
    Given a bookmark has a very long title, description, address, and eight labels
    When the collection is displayed
    Then its card shows at most two title lines
    And at most three description lines
    And a visually shortened address
    And the first three labels followed by the number of additional labels
    And the card remains aligned with neighbouring cards

  Scenario: Edit details shortened on the card
    Given a card visually shortens long bookmark details
    When the user opens its editor
    Then the complete title is available
    And the complete description is available
    And the complete address is retained
    And every label is retained

## Assumptions
===== SCN-022.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Preventing duplicate bookmarks

  Scenario: Save an existing page with non-content address noise
    Given a bookmark has already been saved for a page
    When the user saves an address for that page with only a section jump or common marketing tracking information added
    Then no additional bookmark is created
    And the existing bookmark's editor opens

  Scenario: Save an address whose options meaningfully change the content
    Given a bookmark has already been saved for a page
    When the user saves an address whose search, results page, or view is meaningfully different
    Then the address is treated as a distinct bookmark

## Assumptions
===== SCN-023.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Empty bookmark collection

  Scenario: Open a collection before saving any bookmarks
    Given the collection contains no bookmarks
    When the user opens the collection
    Then the screen says that there are no bookmarks yet
    And it offers an action to add the first bookmark
    And search, label, and other browsing controls are hidden

  Scenario: Save the first bookmark
    Given the collection contains no bookmarks
    When the user saves the first bookmark
    Then the bookmark appears in the collection
    And the search, label, and other applicable browsing controls become available

## Assumptions
===== SCN-024.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Empty filtered bookmark views

  Scenario: Open Read later when no bookmarks are marked
    Given the collection contains bookmarks
    And no bookmark is marked Read later
    When the user opens the Read later view
    Then the screen says that there is nothing to read later
    And search and label controls remain available
    And the screen offers an action to view all bookmarks

  Scenario: Return from an empty Read later view
    Given the Read later view is empty
    When the user chooses to view all bookmarks
    Then the full collection is shown

## Assumptions
===== SCN-025.md
## Gherkin

Feature: Preventing duplicates across the archive

  Scenario: Save the address of an archived bookmark again
    Given a bookmark for the address is archived
    When the user attempts to save that address again
    Then no additional bookmark is created
    And the archived bookmark opens for editing
    And the editor clearly indicates that the bookmark is archived
    And the bookmark remains archived
    And the user can explicitly choose to restore it

## Assumptions

## Gherkin

Feature: Recovering from a failed save

  Scenario: Saving a prepared bookmark fails
    Given the user has entered a valid address
    And has adjusted the bookmark title, description, or labels
    When saving the bookmark fails
    Then the save pop-up remains open
    And it clearly says that the bookmark was not saved
    And every entered and selected detail remains intact
    And no bookmark is added to the collection

  Scenario: Retry after a failed save
    Given a prepared bookmark failed to save
    When the user retries and saving succeeds
    Then the pop-up closes
    And one complete bookmark appears in the collection with the retained details

    Given a bookmark has been saved with its title, description, and labels

    Then the saved bookmark details remain unchanged

    Given a bookmark has been saved
    When the original webpage later becomes unavailable
    Then the bookmark remains in the collection with all its saved details
    And opening it still attempts to visit the original address
